job: Hardening a confidential-inference offering so a frontier model runs inside a hardware TEE with end-to-end TEE-I/O and customer-verifiable remote attestation
outcome: A generally available confidential-inference service for a frontier-class model, with TEE-I/O host-to-GPU and an attestation report the customer verifies before sending prompts
motivation: Regulated and sovereign buyers refuse a GPU they cannot attest, so confidential inference captures the highest-value, least price-sensitive workloads

task.who: the cloud's confidential-computing product and inference-platform engineering team
task.what: Wire end-to-end TEE-I/O and attestation into a frontier-model inference service
task.where: The cloud's managed inference platform and its GA release pipeline
task.when: From the June 2026 summit window through Q1 2027 GA
task.why: Attestable confidentiality unlocks regulated and sovereign inference demand
task.how: Hardware TEE on the accelerator with attestable key release and remote-attestation reports

job: Moving confidential-computing modes and CPU-enclave-to-GPU-memory TEE-I/O links from demonstrable to volume so hyperscalers can build attestable inference on them
outcome: Shipping silicon with hardware root-of-trust, attestable TEE-I/O between host CPU and GPU memory, and attestation services hyperscalers can productize
motivation: Confidential AI is the differentiator that pulls regulated buyers onto its accelerators, so enabling attestable inference grows premium silicon demand

task.who: the silicon vendor's confidential-computing and platform-security engineering group
task.what: Ship volume TEE-I/O links and hardware root-of-trust attestation
task.where: The vendor's GPU/CPU platform, firmware, and attestation service
task.when: Through H2 2026 into early 2027, building on Blackwell confidential modes
task.why: Attestable accelerators win the highest-value confidential-AI workloads
task.how: Hardware root-of-trust, encrypted CPU-GPU memory links, and an attestation verification service

job: Specifying contractual attestation and data-residency requirements that force the cloud to prove no operator or co-tenant can read prompts or weights before any deal
outcome: Signed commitments and design-partner pull that make verifiable confidential inference a GA procurement requirement, pulling the hyperscaler service to general availability
motivation: Healthcare, finance, defense and EU data-residency rules bar sending sensitive prompts to an unattestable shared GPU

task.who: the buyer's security architecture, compliance, and procurement function
task.what: Mandate verifiable attestation and residency as a purchase precondition
task.where: RFPs, design-partner programs, and vendor security reviews
task.when: Through the runway from mid-2026 into Q1 2027 procurement cycles
task.why: Regulation forbids unattestable processing of sensitive prompts
task.how: Attestation-report verification and TEE-I/O confidentiality clauses in contracts
